objective: Materialize Kubewarden as the default repo-local Cloud IaC admission-policy source and add a deterministic fail-closed Oya gate, while preserving Kyverno as a first-class adapter and avoiding any live admission/runtime overclaim.
implemented_claims: Added `oya gate validate cloud-iac-kubewarden-admission-policy` with focused parser/validator tests and run-all/catalog registration.
Added repo-local Kubewarden PolicyServer, ClusterAdmissionPolicy signed-image policy source, and verification-config source under `microservices/cloud-iac/iac/k8s/kubewarden/`.

Updated Cloud IaC manifest with a `kubewarden_admission_policy_scope` that records Kubewarden default, Kyverno first-class adapter parity, policy files, invariants, scalability/stability posture, official sources, and runtime non-claims.
Updated the existing Kyverno signed-image policy with metadata that marks it as first-class adapter parity and not the default admission substrate.
explicit_non_claims: No Kubewarden controller installation, PolicyServer pod scheduling, ClusterAdmissionPolicy apply, admission-controller execution, cosign verification execution, Rekor network call, image signing, Helm rendering, Argo CD API integration, Kubernetes API integration, live sync/diff/health/prune/self-heal/rollout/rollback execution, provider runtime, OpenTofu plan/apply, FD-001 tenant workload hosting, production readiness, or cloud provisioning is claimed.
The new gate is local filesystem/text/JSON validation only; it does not prove policy compilation by Kubewarden, webhook availability, Kubernetes admission behavior, or live signature verification.
Full `./bin/oya verify --ci-required` is not claimed green unless freshly run and proven.
false_green_findings_closed: A Kyverno policy alone no longer satisfies the Kubewarden-default launch directive; this slice adds Kubewarden policy source and an explicit gate.
Signed-image Helm/GitOps parameter wiring still does not count as admission-controller execution; this slice keeps that non-claim explicit.
The gate rejects missing Kubewarden ClusterAdmissionPolicy source and Kyverno adapter metadata drift instead of accepting broad manifest text.
hyperscaler_lens: Kubewarden default and Kyverno parity are explicit, versioned, and mechanically checked rather than left as prose.
Policy source is fail-closed on missing manifests, missing adapter parity, latest tags, and credential-like markers.
The slice improves admission-control substrate correctness without pretending to have live runtime admission, which remains a separate readiness bar.

official_sources_used.establishes: Kubewarden policy flow uses PolicyServer and policy resources with OCI modules and Kubernetes-style rules.
Kubewarden exposes CRDs such as PolicyServer and ClusterAdmissionPolicy.
Kubewarden application collection includes image-signature verification policy patterns.

known_gaps: Future ChangeSet needed for Kubewarden Helm/operator installation or managed-controller deployment evidence.
Future ChangeSet needed for live admission dry-run/apply evidence against a Kubernetes API server.
Future ChangeSet needed for live cosign/Rekor signature verification evidence and negative admission tests.
Future ChangeSet needed for FD-001 tenant workload dogfood deployment evidence on Oyatie Cloud substrate.

findings: Small deterministic local gate plus three policy-source files; no runtime stubs or fake controller calls.
Admission default is mechanically visible, adapter parity is checked, and non-claims prevent false production-readiness signals.
Negative tests cover missing Kubewarden ClusterAdmissionPolicy and missing Kyverno adapter parity metadata.
Default CLI paths mirror live repo layout and manifest scope documents policy files and non-claims.
Focused tests, live gate, Rust quality, and related Cloud IaC gates passed before closeout.

alternatives_named: Kubewarden local source gate plus Kyverno parity
F6_alternatives.selected_rationale: A local Kubewarden source gate makes the default admission substrate mechanically visible while keeping Kyverno first-class.
rejected_reasons: Spec-only and Kyverno-only approaches would preserve the false-green gap.

findings: Gate rejects credential-like markers and latest references in policy source files.
No runtime path changed; PolicyServer source declares replicas but does not claim scheduling.
Signed-image admission source improves supply-chain compliance posture without claiming live enforcement.
Kyverno policy remains present and receives explicit first-class adapter metadata.
Future gaps are separated: controller install, live admission apply/dry-run, cosign/Rekor execution, and FD-001 dogfood hosting.
Oya VCS claim, task plan/todo rows, manifest scope, evidence, and audit-chain row bind the change to user launch directives.
Used Oya VCS claim before writes and used Oya git/status surfaces only.
No new dependencies introduced; gate uses existing serde_json and filesystem text checks.

review_findings: The change moves the repo from prose-only Kubewarden default to mechanically validated local source, while preserving Kyverno adapter parity.
The source-backed live-runtime bar remains intentionally unclaimed.

Scoped governance gates pass; a broader retired-vocabulary corpus that copied dispatcher/catalog files surfaced pre-existing retired terms in old comments, so added-line retired-term scan was used for those modified files and passed.
Oya VCS work/verify/done/promote accepted for local-foundry closeout.
